How every icon is built

  • Grid48 × 48 grid with 4 px padding. Drawn clean on a 0.5 grid, then sketched.
  • InkDark grey #2E2E2E, about 2 px, round ends. Ink always covers the most area.
  • Hand-drawn lineEvery stroke swells and thins about 24% along its length and drifts slightly, like ink from a pen.
  • AccentsLeaf green and tangerine, and every icon uses both.
  • Accent blocksFlat colour shapes with no outline, sitting under the ink. Ink may cross them.
  • Accent strokesAbout 4 px chunky, hand-drawn strokes for wheels, rings, straps and strings.
  • Outlines onlyEvery object is an ink outline. Solid ink only for small marks like the plane glyph.
  • Detail10 shapes at most. Reads at 24 px, and in silhouette at 16 px.
  • RemovedNo rotation, shading, gradients, shadows or text.
  • 16 pxRedrawn on a 16 grid with a 1 px ink line and 2 px accent strokes; seven shapes at most, drawn clean so edges stay sharp.
